Folks, Gemma is a good model & very useful for some purposes, it is not anywhere near the frontier. Inkling is an interesting model, it is nowhere near the frontier. 

This is pretty obvious, you can look at the stats or look at my weird little benchmark: https://t.co/zN2uHY1gl8

We're in such desperate need of better video understanding models.

Generate an AI video with some kind of mirror reflection, take it to an LLM (GPT-5.6, Gemini, Fable), and ask if it makes sense.

You'll get weird hallucinations and contradictory reasoning from all of them 🙃
